findings.highlight: should have nullified any possible impact
findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる衝撃を削減する筈
findings.governingReading: Invisible Air’s wall should reduce impacts of every kind.
findings.explanation: Nullified makes mitigation absolute and overstates the defense that Pegasus overwhelms.

findings.highlight: she rolls on the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 受け身もとれずに地面に転がる
findings.governingReading: Blown away, Saber tumbles across the rooftop without even managing a breakfall.
findings.explanation: The English omits her inability to take the fall, weakening the force and loss of control.

findings.highlight: the trail is enough to chip at her protection
findings.evidenceJa: その余波だけで彼女の守りは削られていく
findings.governingReading: Even when Saber evades, the attack’s aftershock alone erodes her defenses.
findings.explanation: Trail substitutes a spatial trace for the damaging residual force.

findings.highlight: their very existence is a “divine mystery”
findings.evidenceJa: その在り方そのもの
findings.governingReading: The very mode of existence of Phantasmal Species is itself Mystery.
findings.explanation: Divine adds an unsupported property to the Fate technical category.

findings.highlight: surpass magic
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術を凌駕する存在
findings.governingReading: Their existence alone is held to surpass Magecraft.
findings.explanation: Magic erases the hierarchy’s distinction between accumulated Magecraft and stronger Mystery.

findings.highlight: a divine mystery will be eliminated by a greater divine mystery
findings.evidenceJa: 神秘は、より強い神秘にうち消される
findings.governingReading: Mystery is nullified by stronger Mystery.
findings.explanation: Divine is again inserted into both sides of the technical rule.

findings.highlight: magic stored its power in knowledge
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術が知識として力を蓄えてきた
findings.governingReading: Magecraft has accumulated power in the form of knowledge.
findings.explanation: Magic collapses the system category, while making magic itself the agent that stores power.

findings.highlight: Even if one masters magic as a human, that is only about the last five hundred years.
findings.evidenceJa: 人の身で魔術を極めようと、そんなものはせいぜい五百年
findings.governingReading: Even if a human perfects Magecraft, the Mystery such a human frame can accumulate amounts to at most roughly five hundred years.
findings.explanation: The last five hundred years changes accumulated depth into a historical period and leaves the comparison grammatically incoherent.

findings.highlight: Your deeds must have been profound.
findings.evidenceJa: 随分と業が深い
findings.governingReading: Saber remarks that Rider must bear exceptionally deep karma or sin to bring forth something from the Age of Gods.
findings.explanation: Profound deeds removes the condemnatory karmic judgment and can sound admiring.

findings.highlight: I am rather like your enemy.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴女たちの敵だったモノにすぎない
findings.governingReading: Rider says she is merely one of the beings that were enemies of Saber’s kind.
findings.explanation: Like your enemy weakens identity and historical alignment into resemblance to an enemy.

findings.highlight: my boy
findings.evidenceJa: 私の仔
findings.governingReading: Rider calls Pegasus her child or dear creature.
findings.explanation: Boy adds unsupported sex and makes her possessive tenderness sound colloquial and human-specific.

findings.highlight: the class of a demonic beast of the fantastic race
findings.evidenceJa: 魔獣クラスの幻想種
findings.governingReading: A normal Pegasus matures only to the Demonic Beast tier within Phantasmal Species.
findings.explanation: The English is grammatically malformed and obscures that 魔獣 is a rank within the broader category.

findings.highlight: that black cavalry
findings.evidenceJa: あの黒い騎兵
findings.governingReading: The black mounted warrior, Rider, has still not used her own Noble Phantasm.
findings.explanation: Cavalry normally denotes a collective military arm, not one female rider, producing a category and agreement error.

findings.highlight: legendary “divine mystery”
findings.evidenceJa: 神話の中でしか聞いた事のない
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes a legendary Mystery known only from myths.
findings.explanation: Divine again adds an unsupported quality to the revealed category.

findings.highlight: constructed from enough magical energy to have come from a few hundred magi
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師数百人分の魔力で編まれた
findings.governingReading: The white beast is woven from magical energy equivalent to that of several hundred magi.
findings.explanation: To have come from falsely suggests the energy’s actual donors or provenance rather than a quantitative comparison.

findings.highlight: Rider’s Noble Phantasm has already been used.
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの宝具は使われてしまっている
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese moves from the race against time directly to defeating Shinji; the assertion that Rider’s Noble Phantasm has already been used is commented out.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch restores a superseded identification that conflicts with the interlude’s reveal that Pegasus is not Rider’s true Noble Phantasm.

findings.highlight: I ignore it, but the instant I run to Saber
findings.evidenceJa: それを無視してセイバーへと走り出した瞬間
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese cuts from the descending white comet to the instant a storm erupts; Shirou’s run is commented out.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch restores deleted action and changes Shirou’s position and timing at the viewpoint transition.

findings.highlight: Angry at her master for coming to such a dangerous place.
findings.evidenceJa: 主への怒りもある
findings.governingReading: Saber feels anger at Shirou for entering the death ground and at herself for failing to anticipate this natural development.
findings.explanation: The two sentence fragments detach the emotions from Saber’s thought and render the second causal judgment vaguely.

findings.highlight: his expression is only worried about Saber
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の瞳はただ、彼女の身を案じているだけ
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s eyes show nothing but concern for Saber’s person.
findings.explanation: Expression removes the repeated gaze motif, while is only worried is malformed and weakens the bodily focus of his concern.

findings.highlight: makes it beat its wings even faster
findings.evidenceJa: 一際大きく、その翼を羽撃かせる
findings.governingReading: With both hands on Pegasus’s neck, Rider makes it give one especially great beat of its wings.
findings.explanation: Faster invents a change in rate and loses the singular increase in force.

findings.highlight: a mere small rein of shining gold
findings.evidenceJa: 黄金に輝く縄
findings.governingReading: A tiny, otherwise unremarkable golden rope forms in Rider’s hands.
findings.explanation: Rein identifies the object’s function before the dialogue reveals it and narrows the initial visual perception.

findings.highlight: Rider’s
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの意思
findings.governingReading: Pegasus’s beast nature is roused not by its own will but by Rider’s “will,” with 意思 rubied as finger to fuse intention and manipulation.
findings.explanation: The English omits both will and the finger ruby, removing the mechanism that links Rider’s command to her hands on the reins.

findings.highlight: exists only to defeat the enemy
findings.evidenceJa: その敵を討ち滅ぼすのみ
findings.governingReading: As her Master’s sword, Saber now seeks only to strike down and annihilate the enemy.
findings.explanation: Defeat weakens the lethal finality of her decision under threat to Shirou.

findings.highlight: The name is cast.
findings.evidenceJa: 名が紡がれる
findings.governingReading: The True Name is spun or articulated across Rider’s divided utterance.
findings.explanation: Cast substitutes a spellcasting action and loses the image of the name being woven through speech.

findings.highlight: A Noble Phantasm bears a miracle that is released by casting its true name
findings.evidenceJa: 宝具とは、真名を以て放たれる奇蹟
findings.governingReading: A Noble Phantasm is a miracle released by means of its True Name.
findings.explanation: The English makes the Noble Phantasm carry a separate miracle and adds casting, obscuring the definition.

findings.highlight: a miracle is a disaster that should not occur in this world
findings.evidenceJa: 奇蹟とは、この世界では起こるはずのない異変
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese proceeds from the True Name definition to the second half of Bellerophon; the extra definition of miracle is commented out.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch restores superseded exposition and labels the anomaly a disaster.

findings.highlight: there is no need to worry about destroying the earth
findings.evidenceJa: 地上を焼き払う憂いもない
findings.governingReading: Saber says that here she need not fear scorching the ground or inhabited world below.
findings.explanation: Destroying the earth inflates local collateral damage into planetary destruction.

findings.highlight: Many seals develop
findings.evidenceJa: 展開していく幾重もの封印
findings.governingReading: Layer after layer of seals unfolds like a box opening.
findings.explanation: Develop is the wrong process and obscures the seal’s deliberate opening around the sword.

findings.highlight: an assembly of the planet’s light
findings.evidenceJa: 星の光を集めた
findings.governingReading: The strongest holy sword gathers the light of the stars.
findings.explanation: Assembly is malformed for concentrated light, and planet singularly narrows 星 without local support.

findings.highlight: a great disorder in the land
findings.evidenceJa: 大断層
findings.governingReading: Had the strike been used at ground level, it would have left a vast, permanent fault or chasm through the city.
findings.explanation: Disorder is a categorical mistranslation that erases the physical scar establishing Excalibur’s destructive scale.

findings.highlight: only insignificant things come in my head
findings.evidenceJa: おかしなコトばかり脳裏に浮かぶ
findings.governingReading: Disjointed, strange thoughts keep surfacing in Shirou’s mind as he cannot approach Saber.
findings.explanation: Insignificant changes their uncanny irrationality into trivial importance.

findings.highlight: trying to avoid the simplest of the answers
findings.evidenceJa: 簡単な結論を否定したがっている
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes he is desperately trying to deny the simple conclusion about Saber’s identity.
findings.explanation: Simplest of the answers is malformed and weakens active denial into avoidance.

findings.highlight: something “different” from me
findings.evidenceJa: 過去の英雄なのだと知らされ
findings.governingReading: Confronted with unmistakable proof that Saber is a hero from the past, Shirou hesitates to approach her.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch inserts an explicit ontological difference from Shirou that the source leaves as his felt distance.

findings.highlight: Who’s there!?
findings.evidenceJa: 誰だ
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese turns Shirou’s gaze toward the sound without spoken dialogue; the challenge is commented out.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch restores deleted dialogue before Shinji is revealed.

findings.highlight: Shinji is there, watching the burning book.
findings.evidenceJa: ひきつりながら、それを見つめている慎二
findings.governingReading: Shinji stares at the burning book while his face or body twitches and contorts.
findings.explanation: The English omits his involuntary physical panic at the burning Command Spells.
